title: Extend LinBox sparse harness with sparse_dense rows + spmv smoke
description:
Extend `benchmarks/reference/linbox_sparse_bench.cpp` with `sparse_dense,GF(p)` rows via `SparseMatrix::applyLeft` against a dense `BlasMatrix` for each prime in `{7, 251, 65521, 2^31-1}`. Add a LinBox-side spmv × GF(2) smoke oracle to `benchmarks/reference/sparse_smoke.cpp` so the smoke chain has two independent witnesses (fflas + LinBox) for the GF(2) spmv cell. Closes the LinBox cross-check gaps left by 47698404 scorecard § 5 #7.

## Background

47698404's scorecard § 5 #7 documents two LinBox cross-check gaps the design doc named but the harness doesn't currently emit:
- `sparse×dense × GF(p)` LinBox `applyLeft` cross-check (design `dev/plans/sparse_benchmark_corpus.md:169`)
- `spmv × GF(2)` LinBox smoke at n=16 (design `dev/plans/sparse_benchmark_corpus.md:162`)

Today `linbox_sparse_bench.cpp:248-272` emits `spmv` and `sparse-elim` rows only. `sparse_smoke.cpp` uses fflas + scalar reference for GF(2) spmv.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `linbox_sparse_bench.cpp` gains a `bench_sparse_dense<Field>` template emitting `sparse_dense,GF(*)` rows for {GF(7), GF(251), GF(65521), GF(2^31-1)} at n ∈ {1024, 4096}.
- [hard] `sparse_smoke.cpp` gains a `linbox_oracle_spmv` template wired into `main` for GF(2), independent witness alongside the existing fflas oracle.
- [hard] After regenerating `2026-05-04-47698404-sparse-reference.csv`, the file contains `linbox,sparse_dense,GF(7)` / `linbox,sparse_dense,GF(251)` / `linbox,sparse_dense,GF(65521)` / `linbox,sparse_dense,GF(2^31-1)` rows.
- [hard] `benchmarks/smoke.sh` invocation passes with the extended sparse_smoke.
- [hard] 47698404 scorecard updated to fold the LinBox numbers into § 3 sparse×dense × GF(p) tables and § 6 verdict cells.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `doc-review` pass.
